==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|appetiser||Commonwealth only}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|appetize|-er<id:agent noun>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
*{{IPA|en|/ˈæpɪˌtaɪzə/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-appetizer.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪzə(ɹ)|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A small, light, and usually [[savory]] first [[course]] in a meal.
#: {{syn|en|appy|q1=slang|entrée|hors d'oeuvre|starter}}
#: {{co|en|light '''appetizer'''}}
#: {{co|en|vegetarian '''appetizer'''}}
#: {{co|en|serve an '''appetizer'''}}
#: {{ux|en|We ordered soup as an '''appetizer''' before the main course.}}
#: {{ux|en|The restaurant offers several vegetarian '''appetizers'''.}}
# Something that creates or increases excitement for what is to follow.
